description: 臺中市市區公車路線站點資訊 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府交通局. 該資料集為臺中市市區公車各路線路線圖，該資料集彙整、發布時間難免與各公車實際運行情形有落差，最新詳細乘車資訊仍請依本局官網公告為準。. Coverage: 臺中市政府交通局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府交通局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
